notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1041233_gairsoppa.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Upright and intact at nearly 4,700 m some 300 miles south-west of Ireland: the black hull, the holds open, the bridge house, the funnel stump, the lifeboat cradles, the torpedo hole, the opening Odyssey cut into hold 2 in 2012 to raise the silver (a few bars drawn on the bottom beside it). The exact position is not published: the catalog pin is approximate, and so are the damage and the heading (not published here: 0). model_built.glb: the steamer as she was in 1941. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
